local_evidence.excerpt: VLLM_IMAGE is pinned to vllm/vllm-openai:v0.28.0 by digest; VLLM_COMMON enables prefix caching and a 128-sequence cap; QWEN38_COMMON selects qwen3 reasoning, qwen3_xml tools, automatic tool choice, and throughput mode.
local_evidence.note: Configured state only. No backend was started and no active deployment was inferred.

local_evidence.excerpt: The qwen3.8-27b-fp8 lane selects Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8, auto model length, 0.90 GPU memory utilization, FP8 KV, and incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2 with num_speculative_tokens 7.
local_evidence.note: This is the recommended quality-first daily-driver lane. Its custom fastokens image tag remains mutable.

local_evidence.excerpt: The RadixArk BF16-lm-head lane selects FP8 E4M3 KV, 16,384 max batched tokens, DFlash2 K7, and disables FlashInferFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel.
local_evidence.note: Configured throughput candidate and comparison arm.

local_evidence.excerpt: The SGLang BF16-lm-head lane selects FP8 E4M3 KV, flashinfer attention, 4,096-token prefill chunks, LPM scheduling, 262,144 context, eight running requests, 32 Mamba cache slots, and DFlash block size 8.
local_evidence.note: Configured alternative engine; runtime state was not observed.

local_evidence.excerpt: LiteLLM declares separate public model IDs for FP8, Unsloth NVFP4, RadixArk BF16-lm-head, QUASAR NVFP4, SGLang, and NInfer Qwen lanes; FP8 advertises only low reasoning effort.

ChatTemplateThinkingPolicy maps public effort and thinking controls into chat_template_kwargs; a thinking-off request removes stale reasoning_effort values. The Unsloth lane receives its checkpoint-specific xhigh default only when controls are absent.
local_evidence.note: Request-transform behavior read from source; no request was sent.

local_evidence.excerpt: The derived image starts from the pinned vLLM v0.28.0 digest, installs fastokens 0.2.0, and copies the Qwen Froggeric v22.5 template.
local_evidence.note: Image definition only; the mutable published image tag was not resolved or pulled.

local_evidence.excerpt: Historical control: eight isolated 2,048-token decodes averaged 277.253 output tokens/s; a 58.8K-token shared prefix reduced time to first token from 12.414 seconds cold to 1.018 and 1.010 seconds warm.
local_evidence.note: Exact dated local observation preserved from the superseded source. It was not rerun.

local_evidence.excerpt: Historical canary: SGLang DFlash2 K8 averaged 266.966 output tokens/s across eight isolated sequential requests; an eight-stream run recorded 768.220 aggregate output tokens/s.
local_evidence.note: Exact dated local observation preserved from the superseded source. It is not comparable to the vLLM control because engine and configuration changed.

local_evidence.excerpt: The local cache contained unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 snapshot 57926ba; community comparisons associated that checkpoint with reasoning loops, unexpected stops, tool-call failures, and instruction-following regressions.
local_evidence.note: Snapshot existence and community reports are historical. They do not establish general NVFP4 behavior.

local_evidence.excerpt: The prior audit rejected unpublished 93-97 percent MCP rankings, separated model reasoning from parser compatibility and OpenCode skill discovery, and retained Muse Glimmer, GLM-4.7-Flash, Gemma 4 31B, and gpt-oss-120b as comparison arms.
local_evidence.note: Historical audit conclusion retained after current OpenCode skill documentation and model revisions were checked.

local_evidence.excerpt: The service instructions say the bundled vllm-wrapper sleep/wake path is unused and sleep/wake remains disabled pending upstream vLLM fixes.
local_evidence.note: Current configured operating policy only. The exact upstream wake-fix status is not established by this evidence snapshot.

local_evidence.excerpt: The service config sets an eight-hour global TTL and stops each Qwen backend container on unload.
local_evidence.note: Current configured lifecycle only; no backend unload was triggered for this briefing.
